variants.subject: A quick reminder about our preferred title partners
variants.body_template: Hi {{first_name}}, when you route closings through our preferred title partners, clients get a smoother experience and you keep more of the transaction in-house. Reply if you'd like a one-pager on the JV.

variants.subject: Earn $500 more per closing — in-house title
variants.body_template: Hi {{first_name}}, agents who attach in-house title recover about $500 per closing for the brokerage (and a cleaner client handoff for you). Book 15 minutes with your services coordinator to get set up.

variants.subject: Home warranty attach tips for your next listing
variants.body_template: Hi {{first_name}}, a short checklist for offering home warranty at listing appointment. Attach rates climb when you mention it early.

variants.subject: Warranty nudge: +$150 ancillary per close
variants.body_template: Hi {{first_name}}, attaching home warranty adds ~$150 ancillary revenue per close. Try this one-liner with sellers this week.
